title: Zig: Arrays
description: Declare an array and iterate over its elements in Zig.

steps.title: Array Operations
steps.description: Declare const arr = [_]i32{ 10, 20, 30, 40, 50 } and print each element using a for loop.
hints: Use `[_]i32{...}` for array literal with inferred size.
Zig arrays are indexed with `arr[i]` starting at 0.
